notes: Nothing in the second line makes the clause possessive — no הָיָה, no possessive preposition, no free suffix, and no verb the word renders — so the supplied *have* is `added` under rule 43, while the future auxiliary stays with the predicate adjective; the competing reading folds *have* into that unit.
The separately segmented article of לָרָשׁ takes the written *the* (rule 12).
